title: New Job, New Gender? Measuring the Social Bias in Image Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Editing seed images of individuals using gender-neutral text prompts, then applying a commercial face analysis API (Face++) to detect unauthorized binary gender shifts between the original and generated images.

Editing seed images using race-neutral text prompts, extracting facial regions with Dlib, and measuring significant shifts in skin tone by calculating the difference in average grayscale pixel values between the source and generated images.

Editing seed images using age-neutral text prompts, then applying a commercial face analysis API (Face++) to predict and calculate significant age differences between the original and generated images.
